simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֹמֶר (H562) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 6 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֹמֶר (ʼômer) means promise, speech, thing, word. First listed occurrence: Hab 3 9.

definitions.full: H562. omer אֹמֶר noun masculine Psa 77:9 utterance, speech, word , only in poetry, & Josh 24:27 exalted style; — absolute ׳א Job 22:28 5 t.; suffix אִמְרוֺ 20:29 ; Plural absolute אֲמָרִים Prov 19:7 ; 22:21 ; construct אִמְרֵי Num 24:4 +; אֲמָרָיו Job 22:22 ; אִמְרֵיכֶם 32:14 ; Isa 41:26 (on derivation from אֹמֶר compare Di Job 15:33 ) etc.; — 1 utterance, word , especially plural Job 6:26 (|| מִלִּים ) 32:12 , 14 (|| מִלִּין ) 33:3 ; 34:37 ; Psa 5:2 (|| הָגִיג ), 141:6 (on this see compare Che); Prov 2:1 (|| מִצְוָה ), 2:16 ; 4:10 , 20 (|| דָּבָר ), 7:1 (|| מִצְוָה ), 7:5 ; 19:7 ; Isa 41:26 ; words of God Num 24:4 , 16 compare Josh 24:27 ; Job 6:10 ; 22:22 ; Psa 107:11 ; figurative of day 19:3 (singular); compare 19:4 (|| דְּבָרִים ) but see Che on see; of wisdom (personified) Prov 1:21 (|| קוֺל ); often in phrase אִמְרֵיפִֿי Deut 32:1 ; Psalm 19:15 (|| הֶגְיוֺן ); Psa 54:4 (|| תְּפִלָּה ); 78:1 (|| תּוֺרָה ); Prov 4:5 ; 5:7 ; 7:24 ; 8:8 ; compare Job 8:2 ; Prov 6:2 (twice in verse); of ׳י Job 23:12 (|| שְׂפתָיו מִצְוַת ); Psa 138:4 ; Hosea 6:5 (of Yahweh's words as weapon); in phrases אִמְרֵיישֶׁר Job 6:25 ; ׳א בִינָה Prov 1:2 ; ׳א נֹעַם 15:26 ; 16:24 ; ׳א דָ֫עַת 19:27 ; 23:12 ; ׳א אֱמֶת 22:21 , compare אֱמֶת אֲמָרִים הֵשִׁיב 22:21 return answer ; לָהּ אֲמָרֶיהָ תָּשִׁיב Judg 5:29 she returneth (i.e. repeateth ) her words to herself ; א ׳חָשַׁךְ spare (i.e. refrain from) words Prov 17:27 . 2 singular promise Psa 77:9 ; appointment, decree Job 20:29 ; command Psa 68:12 (but see Che); plan, purpose Job 22:28 א ׳גָּזַרֿ ; Hab 3:9 Thes sworn are the rods of appointment (i.e. the chastisements decreed), but passage dubious, see Commentaries; — Gen 49:21 read אֲמִרֵי compare אָמִיד ; see Di.
